*Let me think this through as the farmer myself.*

Well, I'm 63 now, my wife and I are the only ones on the land — the kids are in Shijiazhuang and won't come back except at Spring Festival. 34.5 mu is what my father left and what I've worked all my life. I don't read or write much, so I don't pay attention to what the extension people hand out. I know what works because I've done it 45 times.

About 20 mu I keep in wheat-maize, rotating the same way everybody in the village does. The other 14 or so mu I keep in cotton — I've grown cotton since I was a boy, even though it's more trouble now. Price isn't great some years but I know it, and I don't want to put it all in grain.

**Wheat** — I'll plant around October 5th or so, after the maize comes off. I put down about two bags of 二铵 (DAP) per mu before I plow, that's what I always do. Then when it greens up in spring I top-dress with urea, about one bag per mu. I'll water it in winter (冬灌), then once when it greens up, again at jointing, and once more when it's filling. Four waters usually. The combine comes through in June — costs money but I can't cut it by hand anymore, my back won't take it. I expect around 450 jin... no wait, 450 kg per mu if the spring isn't too dry.

**Maize** — straight into the ground after the wheat combine, no time to plow. I buy hybrid seed from the agricultural supply shop in town — 先玉 or 郑单, whatever the shopkeeper says is selling well. Base fertilizer with the seed, then one top-dress of urea when it's at the big trumpet stage (大喇叭口). If July is dry I water once. I get about 500 kg/mu normally.

**Cotton** — this is the hard one. Plant end of April. I use Bt cotton seed, the bollworm isn't so bad with it, but aphids and blind bugs still come so I spray three-four times. Deep plow before planting. The real problem is picking — my wife and I can't pick 14 mu ourselves anymore. I hire women from the village at around 2 yuan per jin, costs me a lot. Some years I think I should quit cotton but I always plant it again.

I don't keep accounts but I reckon I'll spend around 24,000 yuan on everything this year, most of it on the cotton pickers and the fertilizer.
